title: Lonnie Zamora's Socorro landing
summary: James Fox tells of Lonnie Zamora's Socorro landing, about April 24, 1964 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: landing case that I was investigating at sakur New Mexico that happened April 24th 1964
Lonnie Zamore's famous graph that came down in ' 64 and in New Mexico allegedly had little legs
tellings.difference: Adds that the craft allegedly had little legs.
tellings.link_reason: This is Lonnie Zamora's 1964 New Mexico landing, the Socorro case.

tellings.quote: You have Lonnie Zamora, Sakoro, New Mexico, 1964, where he's this police officer. He sees this egg actually land, sees burnt vegetation in the area.
